newsitem.title: USA: Procter names Grey to Ivory ad account.
newsitem.headline: Procter names Grey to Ivory ad account.

text.p: The Procter & Gamble Co. said Thursday it has hired Grey Advertising Inc. to handle the advertising for its Ivory soap brand in North America.
Grey replaces Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising in that role.
The Cincinnati-based company said Saatchi & Saatchi remains one of its largest ad agencies, with continued responsibility for such brands as Tide, Cascade, and Comet.

In addition to Ivory, the company said Grey handles advertising for a number of other Procter & Gamble beauty care and cosmetic brands, such as Cover Girl, Giorgio, Hugo Boss, Laura Biagiotti, Pantene, and Sure.
Procter & Gamble's stock closed at $117.875, down $3.125, on the New York Stock Exchange.
